item.title: ITC Fragility Index
item.description: Objective To build a business-specific “fragility index” based on the International Trade Centre (ITC) Business Fragility Survey.1 Description The Business Fragility Survey is a national business-level questionnaire aimed at assessing how small and medium enterprises (SME) cope within fragile social and political environments. The Survey contacted around 2,600 businesses from eight developing countries, of which over 1,100 provided complete responses. The Survey was carried out in partnership with domestic business support organizations.

item.title: ITC Instability Indicators
item.description: Objective To build business-specific “instability indicators” based on the International Trade Centre (ITC) Business Fragility Survey and Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED).1 Description The Business Fragility Survey is a national business-level questionnaire aimed at assessing how small and medium enterprises (SME) cope within fragile social and political environments. The Survey contacted around 2,600 businesses from eight developing countries, of which over 1,100 provided complete responses. The Survey was carried out in partnership with domestic business support organizations.

item.title: GII Economy Presentations
item.description: Objective To automatize the production of annual economy presentations for the Global Innovation Index (GII).1 Description In addition to the annual launch event, the GII is also promoted through national release events and stakeholder seminars. As such, there is a need to tailor material in presentation format both from the report and the economy briefs to provide insights specific to each ranked economy within the GII. A sample presentation template from the GII 2022 report can be seen here.

item.title: GII Sources and Definitions Appendix
item.description: Objective To automatize the production of the Global Innovation Index (GII) Appendix on sources and definitions.1 Description To build the GII, WIPO collects a wide array of data from a variety of sources. As such, we must cite and describe how we prepare and utilize the data for transparency purposes. The Sources and Definitions Appendix from the GII 2022 report can be seen here. Previously, source metadata were collected in an ad hoc fashion and synthesized manually.

item.title: GII Economy Briefs
item.description: Objective To insource and automatize the production of annual economy briefs for the Global Innovation Index (GII).1 Description In addition to the ranking and report, the GII launch also includes the release of the economy briefs. The briefs summarize each economy’s innovation performance for the specific report year. They tailor material from the report and the economy profiles to provide insights specific to each ranked economy within the GII. A sample brief for Australia from the GII 2022 report can be seen here.

item.title: GII Data Pipeline
item.description: Objective To transition the Global Innovation Index (GII) from a disjointed data collection and quality control process to an industry-standard, cloud-based pipeline that is collaborative, integrated, reproducible, standardized, secure and documented.1 See related workshop here. Description The high-level workflow of the GII can be grouped into three phases: Data; Analysis; and, Output. Figure 1 outlines these phases along with their constituent steps. Figure 1: High-level GII workflow This project focuses on the Data phase, where we collect, clean and audit all data necessary for the construction of the Index.

item.title: GII Economy Profiles
item.description: Objective To insource and automatize the production of annual economy profiles for the Global Innovation Index (GII).1 See related workshop here. Description One of the main components of the GII report is the economy profiles. The profiles provide an overview of each economy’s performance within the GII for the specific report year. They summarize model output, highlight outdated and missing data, and identify indicator strengths and weaknesses. The profiles for the GII 2022 can be seen here.
